text.zh_CN: 风控部调出了一份历史案例：一家所谓的白马股盘前突发财务核查停牌，开盘直接闪崩 -18%。假设顾言的实盘模拟单日回撤突破了 12%。
text.en: Risk has pulled up a historical case: a so-called blue chip was halted for audit scrutiny and plunged -18% at the open. Suppose Gu Yan's simulated book took a 12% hit in one day.

text.zh_CN: 黑天鹅谁能未卜先知？追求极致阿尔法就必须承受单票暴击。买一篮子 ETF 等于承认自己不知道哪只最好，那只是平庸指数投资者的避难所。
text.en: Who can predict a black swan? Chasing maximum alpha means taking single-stock hits. Buying an ETF basket just admits you don't know what's best. It's a shelter for mediocrity.

text.zh_CN: 市场并不奖赏狂妄的借口。分散投资不是为了消除风险，而是为了不让某一个突发的随机错误毁掉你整年的心血。这就是非系统性风险的代价。
text.en: The market doesn't reward arrogant excuses. Diversification isn't about zero risk; it's about preventing one random mistake from wiping out a year's labor. That is the price of unsystematic risk.

text.zh_CN: 单家企业可能遭遇财务造假、诉讼或技术颠覆，但整个行业指数和宽基市场不会在一夜之间蒸发。接下来的组合架构，你打算怎么选？
text.en: A single company can be hit by fraud, litigation, or disruption. An entire sector or broad index won't disappear overnight. How will you structure the portfolio?
What is your portfolio construction preference?

text.zh_CN: 以 ETF 宽基与行业指数构建核心底仓，平滑波动。
text.en: Use broad ETFs and sector baskets as core holdings to smooth volatility.

toast.zh_CN: 已确立核心配置：ETF 分散化

text.zh_CN: 精选高胜率个股集中持有，靠深度研究博取超额收益。
text.en: Concentrate on high-conviction stocks and beat the market via depth.

toast.zh_CN: 已确立核心配置：个股集中持仓

text.zh_CN: 理性的底仓构筑。关注 ETF 的净值偏离度和管理费率，用被动指数作为防守锚，你才有精力去寻找真正的战术 Alpha。
text.en: Rational foundation. Keep an eye on tracking error and expense ratios. With passive baskets as your defensive anchor, you have the bandwidth for real tactical alpha.

text.zh_CN: 集中持仓会极度放大你的胜负手。如果你选这条路，你的财务审查和安全边际必须比别人苛刻一倍以上，否则你只是在裸奔。
text.en: Concentration magnifies every payoff and every penalty. If you walk this path, your fundamental due diligence must be twice as strict, or you are running naked.

text.zh_CN: 去 ETF 页面查看不同指数的成分股权重与历史表现。记住，学会分散，是你在大浪中保全本金的第一块盾牌。
text.en: Inspect component weights and past metrics on the ETF screen. Remember: diversification is the first shield that preserves your capital in heavy seas.
